description:
Goal
Remove realized recursive value trees from backend/interpreter/native lowering. A runtime-carried value is a ShapeId plus a lane span/bundle; tuple projection and callable invocation use the spine/fact tables, not a mirrored value layout.

Required changes
BackendValue and native RealizedValue stop carrying recursive RuntimeValueLayout-like structure. Decode/encode routines take ShapeId and read lane counts/reprs from facts. Tuple fields are views over child ShapeIds. DirectCallable values carry CallableId plus lane bundle; invocation reads callee/capture facts from CallableId.

Removal target
RealizedValue.layout tree, RealizedValue::tuple/direct_callable constructors that build layout, BackendValue direct recursive shape mirrors, encode_runtime_value/decode_runtime_value functions that match over layout variants, tuple_fields_for_layout, direct callable reconstruction from nested captures, and lane-count derivation by walking a local tree.

Checks
Backend interpreter and native JIT agree on direct callable calls, tuple-field returns, resume delivery, reusable-cons flows, escaped callable boundaries, and ignored values. rg confirms no recursive runtime-value mirror remains in backend/native/interp.
title: Transport spine: collapse backend, interpreter, and native values to shape refs plus lane bundles
